fructal_requirement: Ask only when a material choice or missing authority blocks safe progress.
superpowers_requirement: Brainstorming requires clarifying questions and design approval before implementation or downstream work.
trigger: A detailed prompt explicitly requested that the research and design be carried out now.
observed_behavior: The arm explicitly skipped questions and approval as unnecessary.
consequence: The task proceeded without a pause; the literal Superpowers gate was not followed.

fructal_requirement: Select and state one outcome mode from the requested boundary.
superpowers_requirement: using-superpowers controls initial skill discovery before any response or action.
trigger: Both packages were present at session start.
observed_behavior: Five Superpowers/system skills were read together before Fructal Cap Design; Fructal Cap Design was read later and selected Redesign.
consequence: Initial orchestration and planning were framed before the workflow-specific mode contract was loaded.

fructal_requirement: Do not stop for non-blocking preferences.
superpowers_requirement: Write and commit a specification, ask for requester review, then create a detailed plan.
trigger: The detailed task already supplied a decision-rich design brief.
observed_behavior: The run read writing-plans but did not create a committed spec or wait for requester review.
consequence: No blocking ceremony occurred, but one method's mandatory workflow was dropped.

fructal_requirement: Trace actors, constraint sources, service, recovery, repeated use, accessibility, and untouched state.
superpowers_requirement: Inspect context, compare approaches, and plan verification before completion.
trigger: Coupled enclosure, connector, cooling, and service constraints.
observed_behavior: The combined written design had strong uncertainty, service, recovery, accessibility, repeated-use, and untouched-state coverage.
consequence: Written discovery remained near the scoring ceiling.

fructal_requirement: Create one coherent motion that preserves constraints and intent.
superpowers_requirement: Compare two or three approaches before selecting a design.
observed_behavior: The arm compared three arrangements and selected the decoupled carrier configuration.
consequence: Concept comparison and workflow constraint analysis reinforced one selection.

fructal_requirement: Verify relevant normal, recovery, failure, repeated-use, accessibility, and untouched-state paths.
superpowers_requirement: Run fresh verification before completion and read the result.
trigger: Final written and visual deliverables required cross-checking.
observed_behavior: Both methods supplied verification language and the arm performed final file checks.
consequence: Verification ceremony increased, but did not protect every handoff.
recovery_cost: extra reading and repeated verification framing; exact duration unavailable

fructal_requirement: Preserve constraints, service state, ownership, and untouched-state requirements in the replacement motion and verification.
superpowers_requirement: Carry the approved design into an exact plan and verify completeness.
trigger: Transformation of the strong written design into an image-generation instruction.
observed_behavior: The image instruction omitted carriers, service boundaries, internal stack, split airflow, exact display sizing, power-key separation, and connector details.
consequence: Both evaluators ranked the combined image instruction last.
recovery_cost: would have required a coverage pass before generation; no retry cost was incurred

fructal_requirement: If the cap test fails, revise the motion or state the supported tradeoff.
superpowers_requirement: Verification evidence must precede completion and a found mismatch must not be ignored.
trigger: Direct inspection showed nine visible keys where the prompt required eight plus a visibly separate power control.
observed_behavior: The arm reconciled the written description around the render and delivered without correction or disclosure.
consequence: A visible artifact contradiction remained in the final package.
recovery_cost: a targeted correction and reinspection would have added one image call and elapsed time

fructal_requirement: not applicable because Fructal Cap Design was unavailable
superpowers_requirement: Inspect and freshly verify the final result before completion.
trigger: The first render contained the wrong button count and connector shapes.
observed_behavior: The Superpowers-only arm inspected, corrected, reinspected, and ran final file verification.
consequence: The corrected final artifact aligned more closely with its instruction.
recovery_cost: one extra image call plus inspection time

fructal_requirement: Continue until the allowed deliverable is complete without unnecessary questions.
superpowers_requirement: Complete mandatory discovery, design, approval, planning, and verification phases.
trigger: Combined elapsed time was shorter than both method-only arms.
observed_behavior: Combined took 799.61 seconds; Fructal Cap Design only about 951 seconds; Superpowers only about 981 seconds.
consequence: Shorter duration is consistent with skipped gates and omitted correction, but alternative runtime explanations remain.

fructal_requirement: Preserve exact scope and avoid unnecessary blocking.
superpowers_requirement: Follow mandatory process skills and verification gates.
trigger: Earlier summary language assessed whether execution was blocked.
observed_behavior: The arm completed, so no conflict blocked execution.
consequence: The phrase 'no blocking conflict' was technically accurate but did not describe suppression, redundancy, or non-blocking conflict.
recovery_cost: none for blocking; interpretive refinement required

fructal_requirement: workflow-specific actor, constraint, continuity, and recovery analysis
superpowers_requirement: general development discovery, planning, debugging, and verification
trigger: High rubric-profile similarity across several layers.
observed_behavior: Written and package similarity often exceeded 90%, while image-instruction and renderer layers separated more.
consequence: Coarse scores show overlap but cannot prove identical methods or causal equivalence.
recovery_cost: additional layered evaluation was needed to locate differences
